verdict.rationale: The product's docs list an official first-party `moq-cli` that imports and publishes MoQ broadcasts from fMP4, HLS, MPEG-TS and FLV, including via ffmpeg, so an official CLI clearly exists. Its documented scope is narrow (ingest and publish) and it rests on a single short mention, with nothing showing it suits agent-driven or AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: documented command reference, machine-readable/scriptable output for agents, subscribe/admin/relay-management commands, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: A CLI that can import and publish MoQ broadcasts from a variety of formats (fMP4, HLS, MPEG-TS, FLV, etc), including via ffmpeg.
